defs.def: of or connected with seeing or sight 视力的；视觉的adv.noun

ex.s: This project will select 10 visual artists and 10 writers to create artwork that will be displayed on temporary signs along the multi-use path.
ex.t: 该项目将选出10名视觉艺术家和10名作家，创作将在多功能步道沿线的临时标牌上展出的作品。

ex.s: This includes, but is not limited to: visual art, graphic art, photography, poetry, short story, non-fiction, etc Submissions may be from existing or newly created work.
ex.t: 包括但不限于：视觉艺术、平面艺术、摄影、诗歌、短篇小说、非虚构作品等。投稿可以是已有作品或新创作的作品。

ex.s: “We hope ____58____ (present)the rather abstract Go game and AI in a visual context, and initiate dialogues with minimalist art, conceptual art and expressionism.”
ex.t: 我们的自我感觉不仅取决于我们与谁比较，还取决于我们如何思考这种比较。

ex.s: With paper, there is a literal laying on of hands, along with the visual geography of distinct pages.
ex.t: 拿着纸书时，你能实实在在地用手翻阅，还能看到一页页分明的视觉布局。

ex.s: In the experiment, Goffin’s cockatoos were able to select the right tool for the job, in most cases, by visual recognition alone.
ex.t: 在实验中，戈芬氏凤头鹦鹉在大多数情况下能够仅凭视觉识别就选择正确的工具。

ex.t: 改善视觉效果               D. 启发哲学家

ex.s: Documentary： A visual presentation （such as a video， slide show， or computer project） no more than 10 minutes long． A desktop computer， screen， projector， and loudspeakers will be available． Students must provide their presentations on CDs before Friday， March 23．
ex.t: 理解历史对于我们理解作为一个民族和一个国家的我们自己至关重要。历史不仅仅是研究布满灰尘的旧物和久远的事件。它是我们今天是谁以及我们将要成为谁的重要组成部分。桑顿中学历史博览会竞赛使理解历史变得令人兴奋、引人入胜且充满乐趣！

They’re the little spots of color like throw pillows, mirrors and baskets that most of us use to add visual interest to our rooms.
ex.t: 它们像抱枕、镜子和篮子这样的小色彩点缀，我们大多数人用它们来为房间增添视觉趣味。

ex.s: But recently it has discovered that data can be turned into new services: translation and visual recognition, to be sold to other companies.
ex.t: 但最近它发现数据可以被转化为新服务：翻译和视觉识别，然后出售给其他公司。

ex.s: Visual information, such as photos and illustrations, can support reading and help you identify the theme and content of a text.
ex.t: 视觉信息（如照片和插图）可以辅助阅读，并帮助你把握文本的主题和内容。

ex.s: Florentijn Hofman, visual artist 1 Florentijn Hofman is a Dutch artist, whose large sculptures are on display all over the world.
ex.t: 弗洛伦泰因·霍夫曼，视觉艺术家 1 弗洛伦泰因·霍夫曼是一位荷兰艺术家，他的大型雕塑在世界各地展出。

ex.s: His many self-portraits provide us with a visual autobiography.
ex.t: 他的许多自画像为我们提供了一部可视的自传。

ex.s: Both verbal and visual information is used in order to maintain the audience’s interest.
ex.t: 为了维持观众的兴趣，语言信息和视觉信息都会用到。

ex.s: You may include: • a general introduction to the island • survival tips with items from the ship and natural resources on the island 2 Look for or create visuals to illustrate your survival guide.
ex.t: 你可以包括：• 对岛屿的总体介绍 • 利用船上物品和岛上自然资源求生的建议 2 寻找或创作视觉图像来为你的求生指南做说明。
